findings.description: As the hand lowers the left block, a second blue block clips out from inside it under the fingers, while the separate green block on the right slides rightward across the table before any hand or object makes contact with it.

When the hand grips the rightmost green block and pulls to the right, a duplicate block clips and extrudes directly out from inside the stationary block rather than moving as a single rigid body; this interpenetration/splitting repeats at 00:03, 00:04, 00:05, and 00:06 to generate five additional blocks.
